_note: Generic Chinese base (BASE_09), single-language Sinitic from culture_jinxian.json (kept separately). The celestial court and mandarinate: a Celestial-Mandate realm of walled cities and a Confucian bureaucracy, the Huangdi over the wang and the five peerages. Sinitic sub-palette of the East Asian family (tonal/isolating, monosyllabic, the Mandate of Heaven). civ = feudal. All three alignments allowed per the human-culture standard. Common-word lexicon uses the real Chinese register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are the Sinitic morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_east_asian.json theonym_sets.sinitic), never real Chinese gods. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are ENGLISH; the Sinitic court titles (Wang, Huangdi, etc.) live in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. No approved foreign term applies (no Chinese rank-title on the approved list), so approved_foreign_terms_used is omitted and all display rulers are English.

phonology.palette: Sinitic: monosyllabic morphemes; syllable (C)(G)V(C) with only -n/-ng codas; tones (unmarked); no consonant clusters; surname(1) + given(1-2); celestial titles -di/-jun/-wang.
phonology.phonotactics: tight monosyllables; initials incl. zh/ch/sh/x/q/j; finals -n/-ng; no clusters.

morphology.patronymic_form: the clan-surname (xing) comes first, then the given name (ming); generation-names within a zu (lineage); no patronymic particle.
morphology.compounding_rule: [surname] + [given]; toponyms = quality/feature + type: Jin-cheng (golden-city), Bei-guan (north-pass), Da-jiang (great-river).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Celestial-Mandate realm: the Huangdi over the wang and the five peerages, the Confucian bureaucracy of officials; the celestial court and mandarinate)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Sinitic feudal, ascending; DISPLAY titles English, native Sinitic court titles beneath. The Huangdi (emperor) holds the Mandate of Heaven (Tianming) over the Diguo; the Wang are kings/princes; the peerage descends Gong (duke) > Hou (marquis) > Bo (count) > Nan (baron). The Dudu hold the frontier military commands (march). (Native rank titles are the real Chinese register, allowed; no Chinese term is on the approved-foreign list, so display rulers are English.)
title_ladder.heir: Taizi (crown prince); Shizi (heir of a wang or noble)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH. No Chinese rank-title is on the approved-foreign list, so no native term is promoted to display. The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: surname (xing) first, then given name (ming); a courtesy-name (zi) for adults; generation-names within a lineage.
people_name_convention.dual_register: officials and the learned take a courtesy-name (zi) and a sobriquet (hao); commoners use xing + ming.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Chinese names invoke virtues and the celestial powers' epithets rather than the god-name directly; e.g. Tian-en (heaven's grace), or a temple-name honoring Tuli-di.

religion._note: Deity-names are the Sinitic morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_east_asian.json theonym_sets.sinitic) - never real Chinese gods. A Celestial Bureaucracy under the Mandate of Heaven: the One (Aiteng) presides as Highest Heaven; the Lawful powers are the celestial officials (-di emperors, -jun lords); the Neutral honor ancestors (the zu) and the local earth-and-grain powers; the Chaotic defy the celestial order. Confucian rites and ancestor-veneration order all.
religion.the_one: Aiteng (< Aeternus; the Highest Heaven, the source of the Mandate, served not petitioned)

sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaidun-di (the Earth Emperor, lord of mountains)
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numeng-jun (the Sage Lord of the winds)

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful celestial officials under the Mandate - Aiteng the Highest Heaven, Tuli-di the Sun-Justice Emperor, Gaidun-di the Earth Emperor, Numeng-jun the Sage Lord - and names the Chaotic powers the demon-marshals (mo), warded; the celestial bureaucracy and the rites of the Mandate order all.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: honors the ancestors (the zu) and the local earth-and-grain powers, the celestial court invoked at the Miao situationally; Confucian rites and ancestor-veneration bind.
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - the demon-marshals (mo) outside the celestial order - and names the Lawful celestial officials, and Aiteng, as the tyrant-court of Heaven to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the opposing powers are the demon-marshals (mo) outside the celestial order, each with an epithet: Maraxus -> Maluo the War-Fire Marshal; Vacidus -> Wuci the Devourer; Lusanto -> Lusan the Coin-Serpent.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Miao (temple) of [power]: 'the Miao of Tuli-di'; the ancestral Ci (clan-shrine) for the zu.
religion.saints_pattern: deified heroes and worthy officials enrolled in the celestial register, honored at the Ci (ancestral shrine) and the Miao; 'the Lord [name]'.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tuli-di: a red sun-disc above the scales and seal of office
holy_symbol_motifs.Gaidun-di: a green mountain over the grain-altar

banks_patterns.ships: river-junk and war-junk names: 'the Red Cliff', 'Jade Dragon', 'the Heaven-Mandate'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [general] Ying (camp/army) / the [color] Banner: 'the Tiger Ying', 'the Azure Banner'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen warlord cheng and tomb-mounds: 'the Tomb of [name]', 'the Ruined Cheng of [warlord]'
